what: The closed vocabulary and the invariant that lets one analytical result be shown to different audiences without any audience being told something different. An audience profile may omit a clause or use a shorter registered rendering. It may never change what a clause says.
protected_field_rule: Every field listed above is compared across every pair of roles that carry the same clause_id, by typed canonical digest. Divergence in any one of them is a refusal, not a rendering difference. Shortening prose is a rendering decision; changing a denominator is a different claim.

measurement.why: A role may legitimately carry fewer measurements than another.

limitation.why: The failure mode this contract exists to prevent: a shorter audience view that keeps the number and drops what the number cannot support. A limitation is not editorial trimming.

rights.why: Rights state travels with the claim or the claim cannot be republished.

provenance.why: A claim without its proof binding is unverifiable, and an unverifiable claim in a short view is exactly the one that gets quoted.

omission_rule: The clause_id set of any role must be a subset of the compiled clause_id set. A role may not introduce a clause_id that was not compiled, and may not omit a clause whose kind is never_omittable.
